_comment: Entries taken off the map until the owner confirms them in Notion (Needs checking). Put the entry back into the file named in heldFrom (without heldBackReason/heldFrom) to show it again.

entries.name: Playa de Usil (Mogro)
entries.source: OSM: Playa de Mogro (the leaflet calls it Usil)
entries.description: Beach on the central coast. Listed in the Cantabria Costa Central visitor leaflet.
entries.heldBackReason: Leaflet says Usil (Mogro); OpenStreetMap only has "Playa de Mogro", so the match is assumed

entries.name: Vermutería De Vicio
entries.source: Place named by owner; position from address point Calle Cádiz 18 (coordinates as listed on Gastroranking); details from venue site and web listings (check before going)
entries.description: Vermouth and tapas bar with a wide menu, interior terrace and cosy atmosphere; known for the vermouth of the week, mejillones en salsa, rabas, patatas bravas, croquetas and albóndigas.
entries.heldBackReason: Position comes from a single source (Gastroranking); no map link or second source

entries.name: Lastra café
entries.source: Place named by owner; position from address point Calle Santa Clara 10; details from venue site and web listings (check before going)
entries.description: Specialty-coffee cafe-bar in central Santander with views of the Parroquia de la Anunciación; known for pastrami and bacon sandwiches, cookies, coffee, matcha and lemonade.
entries.address: Calle Santa Clara 10 (Turismo de Cantabria lists no. 12; one review says 13), Santander
entries.hours: Mon 07:00-19:00; Tue 07:00-18:00; Wed-Fri 07:00-19:00; Sat 09:00-13:00; Sun closed (check before going)
entries.heldBackReason: Sources disagree on the street number (Calle Santa Clara 10, 12 or 13); pin is at no. 10
